text: Henderson Avenue intersects the east side of Clinton Street in a "Stop" controlled intersection. Residents have expressed safety concerns for all pedestrians crossing Clinton Street at Henderson Avenue. Based on the Transportation Services review, the installation of the all-way stop control is not technically warranted. However, the installation of all-way "Stop" control at this intersection will enhance safety for pedestrians and motorists at this intersection.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the installation of an all-ways stop control at the intersection of Clinton Street and Henderson Avenue.
